title: Wolf and Spire
premise: Xanthe Eastwick, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent a decade smuggling refugees through the Thornfell mountains since the kingdom of Vael was erased from every map and memory. When the old gods begin answering prayers again, their returning power threatens to resurrect Vael — but only by consuming everyone who escaped it, including the found family Xanthe built in exile. Guided by a fugitive priestess who once served the god hunting them, Xanthe must find the door out of a country that no longer exists. In the end, she chooses to break her oath and speak the unbinding word, sacrificing her sword-magic to seal the door forever, saving her family at the cost of everything she was.
about_author: Zephyrine Ravensworth is the pen name of a former cartographer's apprentice who grew up in mining towns along real mountain passes, where border stories were currency. They write fantasy about people the maps forgot, and this is their second novel.

chapters.title: The Road That Remembers
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Smuggling a sick child through Thornfell, she finds an old shrine burning with new light — the first answered prayer in ten years. The child's mother whispers a word in dead Vaelish that Xanthe's oath compels her to answer. Emotional beat: dread rekindled; the past refusing to stay buried.

chapters.title: A Priestess of Nothing
chapters.summary: Alternating POV with Seraphine, a defected priestess of the returned god Vaelor, who seeks out Xanthe as the only swordspeaker alive capable of finding the old door. Their wary alliance forms over shared guilt. Meanwhile Xanthe's smuggler family begins hearing prayers of their own. Emotional beat: reluctant trust kindling into something tender.

chapters.title: What the Mountain Owes
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. The god's agents — neighbors, friends, the resurrected dead of Vael — close in as the group races to the door beneath the Spire. Xanthe learns the god means to reclaim every refugee as its countrymen, body and soul. Betrayal from within the family fractures them. Emotional beat: love against duty at breaking point.

chapters.title: The Unbinding Word
chapters.summary: Climax and resolution, dual POV converging at the door. Seraphine holds the threshold while Xanthe faces Vaelor and speaks the forbidden unbinding, shattering her oath and her magic to seal the country shut for good. Wounded but together, the family walks home under an ordinary sky. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into chosen belonging.
